title: 4 sun gods… and only 3 are the sun
cover:
4 sun gods.
Only 3 are the sun

scenes.text: Four sun gods. And according to the texts, only three of them are the sun.
Ask who the Greek sun god is, and you will hear: Apollo.
But in Homer and the Hymns, Apollo is the archer of Delos and the god of Delphi. He is not the sun.
The Greek sun is Helios, son of Hyperion: he crosses the sky in his chariot, and sees and hears all things.
When the men of Odysseus eat his cattle, he threatens to go down and shine among the dead.
Sol is Helios in Latin. But Ovid calls the Sun Phoebus, the name Homer gives Apollo. That is where they blend.
Ra is the sun, and also king of the gods. And every night he crosses the underworld in his boat.
To remember it: who sees everything? Helios and Sol. Who rules everything? Ra. Apollo: neither.
Before you believe a myth, ask: which text says so?
Save it, and send it to anyone who says Apollo is the sun god.
